Name: Pokemon Nuzleaf Replaces Wilderness Golem
Author: General_Durandal
Description:
Wilderness Golem Becomes Nuzleaf!

This mod replaces the Wilderness Golem.xnb located in the Characters/Monsters folder in the game directory.
So backup the file if you want to bring back the normal Wilderness Golem.
